programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Topiary Tal; Pups Save a Hum-Ball
programs.desc: Mr. Park has a Chickaletta topiary, but when Digi and Tal try to help, things get worse; Humdinger creates havoc with a moose and geyser as he tours Yellowbone Park in his rolling Hum-Ball.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups and the Power of Flowers; Pups Save the Alien Egg Hunt
programs.desc: A jealous Mayor Humdinger tries to swipe the florist's Easter decorations and winds up on a runaway wagon with Mayor Goodway; mysterious Alien Easter Eggs cause trouble in Adventure Bay.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups vs. The Mayor of the Universe
programs.desc: Liberty and the Poms team up with the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay from being crushed by a giant, flying Top Hat.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Sweet Mayor; Pups Save a Magic Trick
programs.desc: Encased in a huge chocolate bunny, Humdinger is carried away by hungry raccoons; when a magic trick goes awry, the Adventure Bay Easter Festival is overrun by wild bunnies.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Fire Rescue: Pups Save Lizzy's Lemonade Blaze
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger and his kitties accidentally set Lizzy's Lemonade Stand and parts of Foggy Bottom ablaze; it's up to the pups to extinguish the fires.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a T-Rex Tyke; Pups Save a Playful Elephant Calf
programs.desc: When a baby T. rex gets lost, Ryder and the pups go on a mission to the Dino Wilds to help find him; when Everest joins the PAW Patrol for a visit to the jungle, she makes friends with a clumsy elephant calf and then must help rescue him.
